headline: Co-op shares unlocks and makes remote movement and bolt pickups smoother
summary: Co-op players now share owned items, gold bolts and unlocked planets. Bolt drops come from the host's world, fly toward the nearest player and show their pickup flight to other players. Remote figures and world objects move more smoothly over slow connections, with fixes for standing figures bobbing and held-item animation. Native mod builds also gained Android support.
highlights: The multiplayer mod connects to the public OpenRAC server by default.
A member's Ready choice survives an older host update.
Network diagnostics and simulated message delay help investigate remote movement.
Native mods now build against SDK 1.10.1, with new patch versions for Android archives.
